parse_mjcf_from_xml_string: parse an XML string into an MJCF object model using from_xml_string
parse_mjcf_from_file_handle: parse an MJCF model from a Python file handle using from_file
parse_mjcf_from_file_path: parse an MJCF model from a filesystem path using from_path
parse_mjcf_from_zip: parse an MJCF model and assets from a zip file using from_zip
parse_mjcf_with_include: parse an MJCF model that recursively resolves include tags and merges included XML files
